messages:
alex: Heads-up — canary rollout (mixtral-prod) showing a regression for some customers. p50 token latency ~2x on a subset of requests. Looks like FlashAttention is being skipped and we fall back to SDPA for some connections. Posting logs and a quick profile dump.

alex: log excerpt: 
```
[kernel_select] model=mixtral_v1; device=A100; head_dim=50; qk_type=rotary; mask=causal
[kernel_select] flashattn_supported=false; reason=unaligned-head-dim (50 % 8 != 0)
[kernel_select] chosen_kernel=sdpa
[runtime] kv_cache_reused=false; kv_allocs=3; prefix_len=768
[perf] request_id=... p50=120ms p95=540ms (baseline p50=60ms)
```

alex: Also saw repeated KV cache allocations during long prefixes which amplifies the latency hit after fallback.

maria: :eyes: do you have the pprof flame? is the extra time kernel compute or memcpy/alloc overhead from fallback path?

alex: quick flame summary (trimmed):
```
35% sdpa_forward
20% kvcache_copy_realloc
12% cuda_memset (padding path)
8% postprocess
rest scheduling/overhead
```

jon: that head_dim=50 stands out — FlashAttention on our kernels expects head_dim aligned to 8 (fp16) or 16 for certain optimized codepaths. If the model loader didnt add head padding for that exported Mixtral flavor, the runtime will avoid flash kernels.

jon: historically we had two solutions: 1) add headpad at load time (cheap) 2) implement an unaligned kernel in Flash path (hard/slow). Which route do we want?

lee: caution: headpad touches RoPE layout. We previously saw subtle score changes when we padded heads without doing the correct RoPE index remapping. We need validation (unit eval set) before we ship automatic pad.

maria: alternative mitigation: tweak batching heuristics so we avoid large prefix aggregation on requests that are likely to trigger fallback. If batch token count is low, fallback cost is small; big batches + fallback = explosion. Can we gate batching by fallback-probability?

alex: idea for heuristic: if model.head_dim % 8 != 0 -> use conservative batch cap (max_tokens_per_batch = 256) and avoid merging long prefixes. Quick patch reduces p95 in canary by ~30% for affected traffic.

jon: sample kernel selection pseudocode I prototyped: 
```
# runtime pseudocode
if head_dim % 8 == 0 and not has_masking_bug(model):
    kernel = "flashattn"
elif head_dim % 8 != 0 and device_supports_unaligned_flash and flash_unaligned_test_ok(model):
    kernel = "flashattn_unaligned"
else:
    kernel = "sdpa"  # reliable path
```

jon: note the `has_masking_bug` check — a couple of our SDPA/flash combos historically interacted poorly with full-causal masks on certain seq-lens (mask offset bug from 2024-10). Need runtime guard.

lee: for headpad route: steps to be safe: 
- add deterministic headpad in loader for non-aligned models
- update RoPE remapping in loader to keep rotary indices correct
- run regen eval suite (llm-evals quickset + customer stability prompts)
- add fallback-rate metric to Console (per-model) for 24h canary

maria: for batching route: quick A/B shows reducing batch cap for unaligned-head models cuts p95 by ~28% and only raises cost by ~4% overall because more requests keep flash path usable or avoid big reallocs. Worth landing as short term.

ci-bot: perf test queued: `perf/inference/bench --model=mixtral_v1 --kernels=flash,sdpa --head-dim=50 --prefix=768` (job 4582).

perf-bot: preliminary results (canary run): flash path fallback rate=14% -> after heuristic patch fallback=5%; p50 improved from 120ms->70ms for affected cohort.

alex: proposed rollout plan: 
1) ship batching heuristic change (low-risk) -> canary 24h
2) add fallback-rate metric in Console + alert when >1% for any model
3) implement headpad-in-loader + RoPE validation in a separate PR (blocked on eval)
4) long-term: consider unaligned flash kernel if upstream flash authors accept RFC or we implement optimized code.

jon: I'll open the headpad PR with a dedicated test that verifies logits diff < 1e-4 on our regression set.

lee: I'll own the RoPE validation runs and add a smoke eval that runs on every model load for padded models.

maria: small TODOs: add unit test for mask offset bug (repro case), add sampling job that runs with seq lenses [64,512,1024] to catch edge maskcases.

alex: thanks team. For tracking: created issue WIP #INF-6422 with links to the logs and perf runs. I'll monitor canary and report back. :thumbsup:

jon: quick note — if anyone sees a different model (qwen/mistral/mixtral variants) showing similar fallback pattern, post sample head_dim & prefix lengths, we should aggregate.

lee: noted one more gotcha — quantized Mixtral export tools sometimes strip out the padding metadata. We need exporter lint in the CI.

maria: ok, landing batching heuristic first. tagging devops for canary config. :rocket:
